propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Petrum Caelestinum ad summi pontificatus apicem sublimasti,
quique illum humilitati postponere docuisti: concede propitius; ut ejus
exemplo cuncta mundi despicere, et ad promissa humilibus praemia pervenire
feliciter mereamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.text: O God, Who wast pleased to raise blessed Peter Celestine to the supreme Pontificate, and nevertheless, didst teach him to set before that highest of earthly dignities the practising of the virtue of humility: make us, we beseech Thee, following his example, to care not at all for the high things of this world, and thereby to ensure for ourselves, the reward Thou hast promised to the humble of heart. Through our Lord.

propers.text: Oblatis muneribus, quaesumus, Domine, Ecclesiam tuam benignus illumina: ut et gregis tui proficiat ubique successus, et grati fiant nomini tuo, te gubernante, pastores. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.
